newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lower in early trade, builders weak.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lower in early trade, builders weak.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were slightly lower in early trade on Friday, as shares in some construction companies remained weak. They were still weighed down by worries over the sector after Tada Corp filed for court protection, brokers said.
At 0023 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was down 9.40 points or 0.05 percent to trade at 20,322.03. Its September futures fell 130 points to 20,200.
But losses in the Nikkei index were limited by buying of major blue-chip issues, supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar, they said.
